tasks.description: Fix AgentAPI fallback actions to include movement and targeting. EVALUATOR FINDING: Phase 3 all agents died without moving — fallback actions (attack_medium with no target, block, pass, move_to_boss) don't help agents engage enemies or survive. Fix getFallbackAction in AgentAPI.ts to import findNearestAgent and pathfindStep from EnemyAI, and produce smarter fallbacks: aggressive → attack nearest enemy with targetId set, cautious → move away from nearest enemy (pathfindAway) if adjacent else block, hoarder → move toward nearest item, speedrunner → move toward boss entrance. Also log AGENT_ACTION events with reasoning strings to game-events.jsonl in GameLoop.ts after each agent decision — use logEvent({ type: 'AGENT_ACTION', ... }) with the agentId, goal, targetId, and reasoning. This enables the evaluator's decision-vs-fallback counting.
tasks.acceptance: npm run build exits 0. getFallbackAction for aggressive includes targetId for nearest enemy. getFallbackAction for cautious includes movement away from threats. GameLoop logs AGENT_ACTION event after each agent decision with reasoning field. NO_API=true FAST_MODE=true headless run: agents move from spawn positions (grep game-events.jsonl for AGENT_ACTION events).
acceptance_criteria: AGENT_ACTION events logged in GameLoop — grep GameLoop.ts for 'AGENT_ACTION'
Fallback for aggressive includes findNearestAgent — grep AgentAPI.ts for 'findNearestAgent' in getFallbackAction context
Fallback for cautious includes pathfindAway — grep AgentAPI.ts for 'pathfind'
AGENT_ACTION events contain reasoning field — grep GameLoop.ts for 'reasoning' near logEvent call

tasks.description: Fix API timeout and agent survivability. EVALUATOR FINDING: All first-round API calls timed out at 3s. Anthropic Haiku cold-start latency is 4-8 seconds, so initial calls always fall back. Fix: increase agent_api_timeout_ms from 3000 to 10000 in game-config.json. In AgentAPI.callClaude: add exponential backoff retry — if first call times out, retry once with 15s timeout. In GameLoop.ts: add a 2-second initial delay before starting the round loop to give API connections time to warm up. Also ensure agents don't take damage before their first decision — skip enemy attacks in round 1 (agents haven't acted yet).
tasks.acceptance: npm run build exits 0. game-config.json has agent_api_timeout_ms: 10000. AgentAPI retries once on timeout. GameLoop delays first round by 2s or skips enemy attacks in round 1. Headless run with API key: first-round decisions are real (not all fallback).
acceptance_criteria: agent_api_timeout_ms = 10000 in game-config.json — grep game-config.json for 'agent_api_timeout_ms'
Retry logic in callClaude — grep AgentAPI.ts for 'retry' or second fetch attempt
